name: dreamreflection
source:
This story is about a little boy living in great honor with a rich family who encountered the strangest and most unforgettable memories that he would never forget in a nightmare and reality of his life because of his mother. But his dreams might mention something important about him and his past, and how he changes himself until now.

[From [url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/dreamreflection]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一个生活在富裕家庭的小男孩，因为他的母亲，在他一生的噩梦和现实中遇到了最奇怪、最难忘的记忆。但他的梦可能会提到一些关于他和他的过去的重要事情，以及他迄今为止如何改变自己。
